caveats: Seven is raw ZIP range-read count, not established media write-batch count.
Raw-read elapsed time can overlap or include time blocked behind owner-thread media writes; do not sum these clocks.
Compression/finalization counters overlap other phases and are not removable-cost ceilings.
The single retained old-source observation is only a hypothesis source; no comparative or current-base speed estimate.

path.facts: Greedy existing4MiB decoded-source budget and at most1024 entries; ordered resolved writes; only next raw read overlaps previous write. Cancel/join pending read in finally.
Calls bulkAdd('media') and counts complete awaited write cost; media count/progress ordered.
Existing open bulk transaction reused. Media count>=64 and aggregate payload<=4MiB selects64-row statement; otherwise8-row statement.
Synchronous per-statement SQL/bind construction, cached statement lookup, reset(true),bind,step. No per-image transaction/message/timer/await.
Existing SQL-keyed LRU prepared-statement cache. No unconditional per-image prepare.

boundedDiagnostic.priority: Obtain current exact-source cost/geometry before implementing anything.
boundedDiagnostic.preferredReuse: Read ordinary unchanged A Jitendex reports from already-running exact-current qualification when available; retain source/package/fixture identities and raw phases. This confirms whether the old late-media cost remains.
boundedDiagnostic.attributionIfNeeded: One explicitly diagnostic currentdcfc full Jitendex import, no comparison claim. Bound per media write batch: row count, payload byte total, chosen SQL batch size, actual statement row counts, number of cache misses/prepares, existing transaction state; split elapsed SQL/bind construction, cached statement lookup, reset, bind, step. Preserve full stock correctness/media/restart checks and all failures. Declare any instrumentation overlay; no source changes silently attributed to ordinary performance.
boundedDiagnostic.firstNarrowQuestion: Does a9–63-row bounded tail select8-row SQL statements, and is repeated statement execution materially costly? Existing64-row maximum and4MiB byte guard can be retained, but geometry/cost must be proved before any candidate.
boundedDiagnostic.heldAlternative: Only if BLOB persistence dominates and same-format overhead has no worthwhile route, test existing external-media payload storage. This is a physical-layout experiment requiring new prospective proofs and separate browser/memory/lookup qualification.

externalRouteFeasibility.existingSchema: Same media columns; empty content BLOB plus actual contentOffset/contentLength, method0, decoded length; no new binary media format required.
externalRouteFeasibility.ordering: Append exact immutable decoded bytes through current term-content import session, then insert reference metadata in same SQLite bulk transaction; ordered importer callback remains awaited. Existing finish drains stores before publishing; rollback must restore appended content length and SQL metadata together.
externalRouteFeasibility.ownership: Do not mutate generic caller media objects or rely on typed-array shape as immutable. Existing resolved ArrayBuffers are importer-owned; any introduced await must snapshot/privately own its byte views and metadata. Preserve concurrent/cancel/close/purge lifecycle behavior.
externalRouteFeasibility.fallback: Keep generic database bulkAdd and unsupported/non-session paths unchanged. Eligibility must use existing storage/session/format capabilities, never dictionary name or corpus count.
externalRouteFeasibility.physicalDifferences: Term-content bytes and opaque SQLite bytes/layout change; complete media payload and metadata equality, reopen/delete/update/rollback behavior, cold media reads, and full unrelated-storage equality require explicit proof.
externalRouteFeasibility.caveat: Existing coverage demonstrates relevant supported routes, not that a new ordinary-source caller would already be fully qualified. No implementation authorized or acquired here.

decisions.noJMdictGainAssumed: Pinned JMdict has no media payload target; any media-only route would principally target Jitendex.
